mapper.select: SELECT /* getAlimTemp */ ALIM_SITU , TEMP_CODE , TEMP_TITL , ALIM_TITL , TEMP_CONT , LINK_URLX , USEE_YSNO FROM TB_ALTEMP WHERE ALIM_SITU = #{alimSitu} AND TEMP_CODE = #{tempCode} AND USEE_YSNO = #{commYes}
SELECT /* getActiveAlimUserCnt */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT /* getMyAlimList */ ALIMPAGE.USER_NUMB , ALIMPAGE.ALIM_NUMB , ALIMPAGE.ALIM_SITU , ALIMPAGE.TEMP_CODE , ALIMPAGE.ALIM_TITL , ALIMPAGE.ALIM_CONT , ALIMPAGE.LINK_URLX , ALIMPAGE.READ_YSNO , ALIMPAGE.READ_DATE , ALIMPAGE.SEND_DATE , ALIMPAGE.DELT_YSNO , COALESCE(ICON.MIME_TYPE, DEFAULT_ICON.MIME_TYPE) AS ALIM_ICON_MIME_TYPE , COALESCE(ICON.ICON_DATA, DEFAULT_ICON.ICON_DATA) AS ALIM_ICON_DATA FROM ( SELECT ALIMDETAIL.USER_NUMB , ALIMDETAIL.ALIM_NUMB , ALIMDETAIL.ALIM_SITU , ALIMDETAIL.TEMP_CODE , ALIMDETAIL.ALIM_TITL , ALIMDETAIL.ALIM_CONT , ALIMDETAIL.LINK_URLX , ALIMDETAIL.READ_YSNO , DATE_FORMAT(ALIMDETAIL.READ_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS READ_DATE , DATE_FORMAT(ALIMDETAIL.SEND_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS SEND_DATE , ALIMDETAIL.DELT_YSNO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY ALIMDETAIL.SEND_DATE DESC , ALIMDETAIL.ALIM_NUMB DESC ) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT ALIM.USER_NUMB , ALIM.ALIM_NUMB , ALIM.ALIM_SITU , ALIM.TEMP_CODE , ALIM.ALIM_TITL , ALIM.ALIM_CONT , ALIM.LINK_URLX , ALIM.READ_YSNO , ALIM.READ_DATE , ALIM.SEND_DATE , ALIM.DELT_YSNO FROM TB_ALIMXX ALIM WHERE ALIM.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND COALESCE(ALIM.DELT_YSNO, #{commNo}) = #{commNo} ) ALIMDETAIL ) ALIMPAGE LEFT JOIN TM_ALICON ICON ON ICON.ALIM_SITU = ALIMPAGE.ALIM_SITU LEFT JOIN TM_ALICON DEFAULT_ICON ON DEFAULT_ICON.ALIM_SITU = #{alimSituDefault} WHERE ALIMPAGE.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY ALIMPAGE.ROW_NUMB
